summary: Cementos Pacasmayo S.A.A. (CPAC) filed a Form 6-K on July 16, 2026, responding to Peruvian regulator SMV's inquiries regarding Holcim Ltd.'s indirect acquisition of 50.01% of CPAC's share capital via Inversiones ASPI S.A., triggering an obligation to launch a tender offer under Peruvian OPA regulations. Exact price, premium, and date are not stated in the excerpt. The filing discloses no board recommendation or advisor. Mechanics involve regulatory oversight by SMV on the tender offer process. Watch for SMV's decision on the tender offer terms and Holcim's compliance; risk-arb centers on regulatory clearance and minority shareholder response.
